mcqs.question: How many Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) plants is Reliance Industries planning to set up in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: Reliance Industries is planning to establish approximately 500 Compressed Bio-Gas plants in Andhra Pradesh. The figures 100 and 250–500 relate to the capacity of the first plant and jobs per plant, respectively, while 20 lakh is the state’s five-year job target.
